About Wild

Born from a Passion for the Untamed Horizon

Founded in 2018, Wild redefines luxury travel by placing high-architecture sanctuaries in Earth's most breathtaking, untouched landscapes.

Corporate Heritage

The evolution of off-grid hospitality.

From our initial titanium shelter prototype in Reykjavik to 64 sanctuaries worldwide.

2018 · Inception

The Maiden Pod Prototype

Engineered the world's first self-sustaining cliff dwelling in Reykjavik, using aerospace titanium and aerogel thermal insulation.

2020 · Fleet Expansion

Autonomous Overland Rovers

Introduced custom all-electric AWD expedition campers with integrated solar canopies and satellite emergency tracking.

2022 · Scaling Peaks

The Cloud Sanctuary Network

Expanded to 28 cliff-mounted aeries and alpine pods across the European Alps, Dolomites, and Patagonian Andes.

2024 · Clean Tech

100% Net Zero & Atmospheric Water

Became the first luxury expedition operator certified carbon negative, extracting 100% of drinking water directly from fog and atmosphere.

2026 · Global Presence

64 Sanctuaries Across 5 Continents

Celebrating 14,800+ completed private expeditions with zero ecological incidents and an unmatched 99.8% solitude rating.

Engineering Specifications

Built like spacecraft. Crafted like sanctuaries.

Each component is selected for maximum reliability in extreme natural environments.

Titanium Frameworks

Grade-5 titanium structural trusses resistant to 240 km/h wind shear and seismic vibration.

Solid-State Microgrids

Solid-state batteries operating down to -40°C with automated thermal balancing and solar tracking.

Atmospheric Harvesters

Harvests up to 80 liters of mineral-pure water daily from ambient mountain fog and humidity.

Starlink Mesh Uplinks

Redundant dual-constellation satellite receivers delivering uninterrupted 350 Mbps connectivity.

Governance & Inquiries

Frequently asked questions.

Essential information on accessing our private sanctuaries and booking expeditions.

Depending on the terrain, guests are transferred via our private seaplanes, twin-turbine helicopters, or bespoke AWD overland rovers. A dedicated Wild expedition ranger guides your party directly from the nearest regional private airfield to your sanctuary dock.

Every sanctuary is equipped with real-time biometric telemetry, automated external defibrillators (AED), hyperbaric emergency chambers (at high-altitude aeries), and satellite SOS links with 24/7 airborne medevac extraction coverage.

Yes. Qualified drivers complete a comprehensive 90-minute all-terrain telemetry orientation at our dispatch base. We also provide on-demand professional wilderness pilots if you prefer to relax and enjoy the landscape.

All sanctuaries utilize closed-loop bio-filtration, non-invasive ground anchors without concrete foundations, solar solid-state micro-grids, and zero-emission electric transportation. When a pod is relocated, the ground beneath remains 100% undisturbed.

If extreme meteorological conditions prevent safe airborne transfer, Wild provides complimentary luxury lodging at our regional basecamp and flexible priority re-routing to an alternate sanctuary within our global network.
